s.note: the monkeys tearing through the kitchen
s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 200ml sparkling water and a pinch of sugar. Dip thick slices of 4 bananas and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Roll in 80g sugar mixed with cinnamon while hot.

s.note: everything comes charging through the house
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips on a tray, spoon over 400g refried beans warmed with 1 tsp cumin and cover with 200g grated cheese. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes and top with 200g salsa, 150g sour cream and jalapenos. Serve straight from the tray while the cheese is still stretchy.

m.n: Van Pelt's juniper venison and redcurrant
m.note: the hunter who comes out of the game
m.how: Crush 1 tsp juniper berries with 1 tsp pepper and thyme and rub over 800g venison backstrap. Sear in a hot pan 3 minutes a side for rare and rest 8 minutes. Add 250ml beef stock and 2 tbsp redcurrant jelly to the pan and reduce until glossy, then whisk in 20g butter. Boil 600g parsnips and 400g potatoes until soft and mash with 60g butter.

w.note: Brantford, New Hampshire in the fall
w.how: Boil 250ml maple syrup, 200g brown sugar, 150ml cream and 40g butter to 115C, stirring gently. Cool 10 minutes, then beat until thick and losing its gloss and stir in 60g toasted chopped walnuts. Spread in a lined 15cm tin, cool and cut into squares.

d.n: Brantford mulled apple and maple punch
d.note: a New Hampshire autumn in Brantford
d.how: Warm 1L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 strips orange peel and 2 tbsp maple syrup over low heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Strain into four mugs and add a fresh cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each.
